summary: APT publication exposes new indexes before uploading the package files they name.
scenario: Release publication uploads dists metadata successfully, then the pool upload fails; the live Packages index advertises the new .deb while that object is absent. Publisher exits nonzero but leaves the repository broken for installs/upgrades until a repair or retry.

evidence.point: rclone sync of each live dists suite precedes rclone copy of additive pool files.
The release job validates the local repository, publishes to R2, and runs live smoke checks only after publication succeeds.
Live smoke checks fetch signed metadata and Package names, not the package payload objects referenced by their Filename fields.

trace: package-publish APT job -> validate local repository -> publish.sh sync live dists -> pool copy failure -> set -e abort -> new index remains live with absent payload

authority.source: failure-mode; rclone sync command documentation https://rclone.org/commands/rclone_sync/
authority.quote: A published APT index must only reference package objects available to clients. Separate rclone invocations do not provide a cross-call commit barrier.

summary: The fixture harness ignores verify.timeout_s and passes an executable that exceeds its deadline.
scenario: A fixture declares verify.timeout_s=1 and runs a bounded program for 1.25 seconds per verify phase; the real baseline harness waits for every program and returns success. A hung restored executable therefore blocks the entire sequential e2e gate until the outer CI timeout, rather than failing this verification and writing its result.

evidence.point: Verify documents waiting up to timeout_s and deserializes its value with default 30.
run_verify uses Command.output without consulting timeout_s.
The required gate runs the sequential baseline fixture harness and handles result files only after it returns.

trace: CI e2e gate -> kache-scenario -> fixture_runner::run -> runner::run_phase -> run_verify -> blocking Command.output -> deadline exceeded yet passed=true

authority.quote: The contract: spawn run, wait up to timeout_s, assert expected_exit_code and stdout strings.
